# urmzd.com

> Personal website of Urmzd Mukhammadnaim — software engineer, researcher, and writer. Features projects, research papers, and blog posts on engineering, critical thinking, and philosophy.

## About

Urmzd Mukhammadnaim is a software engineer with a background in evolutionary computation and machine learning research from Dalhousie University. This site showcases open-source projects, published research, and long-form writing.

- GitHub: https://github.com/urmzd
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/urmzd
- X: https://x.com/urmzd_
- Email: hello@urmzd.com
- arXiv: https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&query=Mukhammadnaim,+U

## Blog

- [Hey, I'm Urmzd!](https://urmzd.com/blog/welcome): The meaning behind 'Urmzd' — from its Zoroastrian roots in ancient Badakhshan to the principles of honesty, freedom, and family that guide everything on this site. Plus: the math that powers AI search.
- [An Introduction to Critical Thinking](https://urmzd.com/blog/critical-thinking): LLMs make answers easy to get and hard to verify. The most important skill of the AI age is the loop of questioning, researching, validating, reflecting — and repeating.
- [Silent Execution: The Discipline Behind Clear Thinking](https://urmzd.com/blog/sh): Marcus Aurelius, Stanislav Petrov, and a 14-year-old Muay Thai fighter share the discipline of silence — separating thought from action, signal from noise.

## Projects

- [Dotfiles](https://urmzd.com/projects/dotfiles): Cross-platform dev environment via chezmoi + Nix. Includes 13 composable dev shells, agent skills for AI tools, terminal configuration, and automated bootstrap for macOS and Linux.
- [Resume Generator](https://urmzd.com/projects/resume-generator): Data-driven CLI tool that converts YAML, JSON, or TOML resume data into polished PDFs, DOCX, HTML, LaTeX, and Markdown — with multi-agent AI assessment via Ollama.
- [Semantic Release](https://urmzd.com/projects/semantic-release): Configurable trunk-based semantic release CLI for Rust — analyzes conventional commits, determines version bumps, generates changelogs, creates git tags, and publishes GitHub releases.
- [GitHub Metrics](https://urmzd.com/projects/github-metrics): TypeScript tool that collects and visualizes GitHub contribution metrics. Generates SVG charts for language usage, expertise areas, and contribution pulse.
- [OpenAPI Generator](https://urmzd.com/projects/openapi-generator): Rust-powered code generator that turns OpenAPI 3.x specs into zero-dependency TypeScript clients, SWR hooks, and SSE streaming utilities for React.
- [Linear Genetic Programming Framework](https://urmzd.com/projects/linear-gp): Production-grade Rust framework for LGP research with Q-Learning integration, parallel fitness evaluation, and Optuna hyperparameter optimization.

## Research

- [Reinforced Linear Genetic Programming](https://urmzd.com/research/linear-gp-thesis): Honours thesis proposing RLGP, a hybrid that layers Q-Learning on top of LGP to learn optimal register-action assignments. Evaluated on OpenAI Gym CartPole-v1 and MountainCar-v0. Dalhousie University, 2023. [Paper](https://web.cs.dal.ca/~mheywood/Thesis/UMukhammadnaim.pdf)
- [The Lepus Classifier](https://urmzd.com/research/lepus-classifier): CNN image classification on a 85-image dataset of rabbits and hares. Explores methods to improve CNN performance without large datasets or specialized hardware. Dalhousie University, 2022. [Paper](https://github.com/urmzd/lepus-classifier/blob/main/docs/report-docs/lepus-classifier-report.pdf)
- [Classification of Ailments Given Description of Symptoms](https://urmzd.com/research/md-classifier): CNN-based medical condition prediction from natural language symptom descriptions. One-Hot CNN achieved 90% recall with perfect precision on select conditions. Dalhousie University, 2022. [Paper](https://github.com/urmzd/md-classifier/blob/main/p1.pdf)
